comment: Where a manifest folder lives inside the model store (VEWBOX_MODELS_ROOT; docs/MODELS-STORAGE.md). The manifest and the fetcher's .manifest-state.json keep LOGICAL folders (ComfyUI's type names, `asr/...`, `tts/...`); on disk ComfyUI's typed folders sit together under comfyui/ (extra_model_paths base_path /models/comfyui) and the caches under cache/. Every other folder keeps its name. Read by docker/models/fetch.py and scripts/lib/models-store.mjs: change both sides through this file only.

categories.comfyui: ComfyUI's typed tree: video (MiniMax H3), images (Qwen-Image, FLUX.2 klein, JoyAI), music (ACE-Step, MiniMax Music 3), their text encoders, VAEs and LoRAs, the MediaPipe face detector
categories.asr: Whisper large-v3 (CTranslate2) and the Arabic-dialect fine-tune (transformers + CTranslate2)
categories.align: wav2vec2 CTC models for forced alignment
categories.tts: voices: IndexTTS 2.5, Habibi IRQ, VoxCPM2, the voice-bench engines
categories.identity: face detection/recognition ONNX (YuNet, SFace, CCIP, DINOv2-small)
categories.llm: llm/qwen3.8-27b-fp8 is the production planner (Hugging Face layout, served by vLLM, read-only); llm/ollama is Ollama's /root/.ollama (models/blobs + manifests: the Gemma emergency fallback)
